mapper.sql: id, registration_id, seat_no, generation, owner_member_id, owner_type, owner_id, topic_id, status, token_nonce, token_hash, expires_at, invitee_member_id, claimed_at, create_time, update_time, version
mapper.insert: insert into cms_registration_seat_invitation (registration_id, seat_no, generation, owner_member_id, owner_type, owner_id, topic_id, status, token_nonce, token_hash, expires_at, invitee_member_id, claimed_at, create_time, update_time, version) values (#{registrationId}, #{seatNo}, #{generation}, #{ownerMemberId}, #{ownerType}, #{ownerId}, #{topicId}, #{status}, #{tokenNonce}, #{tokenHash}, #{expiresAt}, #{inviteeMemberId}, #{claimedAt}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{version})
mapper.select: select from cms_registration_seat_invitation where id = #{id} for update
select from cms_registration_seat_invitation where token_hash = #{tokenHash} for update
select from cms_registration_seat_invitation where registration_id = #{registrationId} order by seat_no, id
select from cms_registration_seat_invitation where registration_id = #{registrationId} and status in (0, 1) order by seat_no, id for update
mapper.update: update cms_registration_seat_invitation set status = 1, invitee_member_id = #{inviteeMemberId}, claimed_at = #{now}, update_time = #{now}, version = version + 1 where id = #{id} and status = 0 and invitee_member_id is null and expires_at > #{now}
mapper.select: select coalesce(max(generation), 0) from cms_registration_seat_invitation where registration_id = #{registrationId} and seat_no = #{seatNo}
select count(*) from cms_registration_seat_invitation where registration_id = #{registrationId} and status in (0, 1)

select ( exists (select 1 from topic_route_session where member_id = #{memberId} and topic_id = #{topicId} and activity_id = #{activityId}) or exists (select 1 from player_node_progress where member_id = #{memberId} and topic_id = #{topicId} and (activity_id = #{activityId} or (#{activityId} = 0 and activity_id is null))) or exists (select 1 from orient_task_attempt where member_id = #{memberId} and topic_id = #{topicId} and activity_id = #{activityId}) or exists (select 1 from orient_task_completion where member_id = #{memberId} and topic_id = #{topicId} and activity_id = #{activityId}) or exists (select 1 from game_runtime_session where topic_id = #{topicId} and activity_id = #{activityId} and ((owner_type = 1 and owner_id = #{memberId}) or owner_type = 2)) or exists (select 1 from game_session where activity_id = #{activityId} and #{activityId} > 0 and (started_at is not null or coalesce(status, '') not in ('PREPARING', 'READY'))) )

select i.id as invitation_id, i.registration_id, i.seat_no, i.invitee_member_id from cms_registration_seat_invitation i join cms_registration r on r.id = i.registration_id where i.status = 1 and i.invitee_member_id = #{memberId} and r.owner_type = #{ownerType} and r.owner_id = #{ownerId} and i.owner_type = r.owner_type and i.owner_id = r.owner_id and i.owner_member_id = r.member_id and i.seat_no between 2 and r.order_num and r.registration_status = 2 and r.payment_status = 2
